typeHelp: Changing the type preserves the record’s sections, evidence and history. Existing run relationships must remain valid. Template records keep the type assigned by their template.
finishingSave: Changes saved. Finishing recovery checkpoint cleanup…
resultInvalid: Enter a title, statement and scope or limitations. A figure result needs a figure or panel; a retained result needs its saved source revision.
removeResultHelp: Save changes to remove the statement from the current record. Earlier revisions and retained source data remain available.
resultAbsent: This statement is not present in the saved record.
resultNoFigures: This record has no figures yet.
confirmRemoveTag: Remove the tag “{tag}” from this record? Earlier revisions keep it.
tagPending: A tag change has not been acknowledged. Retry it to check the saved result.
tagInvalid: Enter a tag name using 1 to 40 characters.
tagRenameChanged: The tags changed while you were editing. Your unfinished name is “{name}”. Choose Rename tag on the intended current tag to apply it after review, or Cancel.
attemptDraftHelp: Save adds this fact to the record. Unfinished fields are kept in a recoverable draft. Earlier facts remain unchanged; amendments and corrections are new entries.
attemptAbsent: This fact has not been saved. Close this view and start an addition from the record.
attemptConflictHelp: Another preparation or correction was saved. Review it below. Keep my edit will apply your draft as a correction of the latest fact and require a new reason. Earlier facts stay unchanged.
heading: Edit {field}
noContributors: No contributors listed. Add people to credit their work on this record.
removeContributorHelp: Save changes to remove this attribution from the current record. Earlier revisions keep it.
contributorAbsent: This contributor is not listed in the saved record.
figureAbsent: This figure is not present in the saved record.
confirmRemoveFigure: Remove “{title}” from this record? Earlier revisions and retained calculation sources will remain available.
figurePending: The figure operation has not been acknowledged. Retry it to check the result.
mediaHelp: Describe the media for readers. Changes apply only to this record.
mediaShare: Make this media available for website publication
mediaShareHelp: Review its visible and audible content before sharing. This makes the media eligible for selection when its record is published; it does not publish anything now.
relationReferenceHelp: Choose a target below, or paste an Observanda reference copied from another record, project, lab book or workspace. Exact references keep the selected revision when the target is edited later.
removeRelationHelp: Save changes to remove the current link. Earlier revisions retain the reference.
relationAbsent: This link is not present in the saved record.
relationInvalidReference: Enter a complete Observanda reference or choose a target.
relationRoleTarget: Choose a record in this workspace with the version required by this relationship purpose.
relationPinChanged: The retained revision changed. Refresh the target list and choose again.
title: Record title
checkpointFailed: The recovery checkpoint could not be saved. Keep this window open and try again.
savedDraftRemains: Record detail saved. Its recovery checkpoint is still available because cleanup did not finish.
invalidRead: The selected content response was incomplete. Close this window and open the editor again.
invalidCheckpoint: The recovery checkpoint response was incomplete. Retry the checkpoint to check its result.
invalidSave: The save response was incomplete. Your edit is retained. Save again to check its result.
confirmDiscard: Discard this edit and its checkpoint?
conflict: This detail changed in another session. Compare the saved value with your edit before choosing which to keep.
failed: This detail could not be opened. Try again.
changedWorkspace: The workspace changed. The retained checkpoint remains available in its original workspace.
copyPlotHelp: Copies retain their saved calculations and supporting results.
copyPlotInvalid: The plot response was incomplete. Your figure is unchanged. Try again.
copyPlotFailed: The saved plot could not be opened. Your figure is unchanged. Try again.
